lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Four crates. Ration packs, medical, and one crate of nothing but forms. They were moving paperwork under armed guard.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Of course they were. The paperwork is the thing that matters. It always was.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Take the plate. Cut down off a carrier by somebody who had no torch and plenty of time.
